scenarios.name: Flow — Visa Estimated/Initial Authorization followed by Incremental Authorization then Completion (Financial Transaction Request → Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture) [boundary-at-limit-sequence-number]

parameters.Sequence Number: <flow at-limit valid value, exact max length>

links.rule: Incremental authorization requests contain the same Sequence Number as the estimated or initial transaction request.

Declared explicitly (2026-10-01) because carry_obligations.py's auto-derivation can never reach this step: it resolves origin steps by matching Transaction Type code, and step 1 and step 2 both use code '3', so step 2 is itself treated as an origin candidate and skipped. Appendix AE (p.722) says BUYPASS 'will identify the transactions as incremental based on the approval code that the merchant sends ... in the subsequent transactions' — the incremental leg must carry the estimated/initial leg's own response approval code.

Contains the same Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111) as the estimated or initial transaction request. Table 063's own layout (p.609-610): Table Data = Arrival Date (positions 1-4) + Duration (5-6) + Terminal Transaction Number (7-10) + Preferred Customer Indicator (11). Only takes effect when step 1's own composed request already carries a Table 063 row — never fabricated (composer.py::_carry_var_info_table_field).
In the case of a preauthorized transaction, the Sequence Number in the Purchase/Capture identifies the Sequence Number in the transaction's Authorization Only request.
